findings.summary: Comparator classification contradicted frozen numerical contract V3.
Event 04 diagnostic record was indistinguishable from authoritative primary payload.
Release closure vocabulary was not fully ordered or mechanically derived.
Bounded validation and payload derivation were incomplete for top32 and other control artifacts.
Comparison summary did not bind compared payload SHAs.
Historical observation literals appeared in new implementation.
Stream validation retained a same-fd mutation window and redundant reads.
Acyclicity counters were asserted rather than derived.
Primary terminal manifest binding was optional.
Producer identity was census-only and parent no-follow was absent.
Comparator branch and diagnostic converter test coverage was incomplete.
